data.name: Woodgas Pyrolytics Inc
data.description: Woodgas Pyrolytics, Inc. is an Illinois-based small company led by Dr. Paul S. Anderson ("Dr TLUD") that develops and disseminates small- and medium-scale biomass pyrolysis technology, including the patented RoCC (Rotatable Covered Cavity) kiln for biochar production. The company supports deployments globally, particularly in Africa, Asia, and Latin America, with biochar used for carbon sequestration and soil amendment.
